vibe: innovative, sustainable, modern, fresh, sleek, elegant and marketing-driven

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-light to font-medium

typography.pairing_strategy: Outfit for highly modern, sleek geometric headings that feel approachable ('fresh and fruity'). Manrope for exceptionally clean, readable body copy for the older demographic.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-full for pills and primary buttons
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards, shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(2,192,255,0.15)] for primary hover states
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-gray-100, occasionally 1px solid border-[#02C0FF]/20 for active/highlighted cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/40 (used for sticky nav and floating cards)

layouts.hero: Asymmetric split or overlay. Large typography on the left, an abstract light blue fluid visual on the right. Clear CTA buttons.
layouts.services_grid: Bento Grid (Grid Cols 1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Each service gets a card with a subtle hover lift and cyan accent.
layouts.portfolio_grid: Tetris-style masonry or asymmetric grid (col-span-8 and col-span-4 mix) to look highly creative and not rigid.
layouts.about: Editorial layout. Text-heavy but broken up by large negative space and high-quality photography.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and cast a slightly tinted cyan shadow. Buttons scale slightly (scale-105).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (framer-motion) for lists and grids. Blur-in for hero text.

components.navigation: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Must include logo, multilang toggle (NL/EN), main links, and 'Offerte' CTA.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#02C0FF] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#0099CC] hover:shadow-lg transition-all. Secondary: bg-white text-[#0A192F] border border-gray-200 rounded-full hover:border-[#02C0FF].
components.cards: White background, rounded-2xl, soft ambient shadow. Icon inside a pale cyan circle (bg-[#E6F8FF] text-[#02C0FF]).
components.forms: Minimalist inputs, border-b only or very subtle rounded-lg with gray-100 bg. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#02C0FF]/50.

pages_structure.Home: Hero with strong Value Prop ('Your Complete Digital Partner') -> Services Bento Grid -> Social Proof/Testimonials -> Pricing/Offerte Teaser -> Footer.
pages_structure.Over ons (About Us): Brand story (Pear symbolism: fresh, growing, sustainable). Office imagery mixed with text.
pages_structure.Diensten (Services): Deep dive into the 4 core services. Alternating left/right image and text blocks.
pages_structure.Portfolio: Masonry grid of case studies showing diverse digital solutions.
pages_structure.Contact: Split layout: Left side contact info and map, Right side form (Name, email, phone, message).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over cyan backgrounds is deep navy or pure white depending on APCA ratio.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#02C0FF] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Outfit' and 'Manrope'. Configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Use framer-motion for simple stagger animations on page load. Do NOT make animations overly slow or distracting.
Implement multi-language toggle (NL/EN) in the navigation bar using context or a simple state for the prototype.
Avoid the generic 'SaaS look'. Make it feel like a high-end creative agency by utilizing large padding (py-20, py-32), large thin/medium typography, and intentional asymmetry.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use a glassmorphic effect so text remains readable.
Do NOT use placeholders for images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs and the PearBlue logo.
Ensure the '#02C0FF' cyan is used purposefully for primary actions and accents. Do not overwhelm the page with it. Use the white/off-white space to let the cyan pop.
Implement the 5 requested pages using React Router or similar.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and major sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-full buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
